text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day the world's been<n>waiting for! It's
time for my debut! I<n>even spot Taiki watching me
from the<n>stands!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We're the strongest runners in our<n>generation! Now
be blown away by<n>my passionate and stunning
debut!
